disposition_reason: The only delivered artifact is a legacy programme manifest declaring 80 participant/ROI outputs. Its numerical grader is separate and unread in that source; restore an inspectable complete scorer and authenticate Version A/B response joins before claiming functional encoding.

scientific_target.question: Can a frozen video-feature encoder predict prepared fMRI response estimates for held-out videos within each participant, beyond matched static/motion/time controls?
scientific_target.known_answer: Private prepared trial/video response estimates in a frozen coordinate/ROI space and processing branch; not a published correlation number.
scientific_target.answer_origin: BOLDMoments source response derivatives aligned to stimulus/video/trial identities; Version A and Version B are different measurements and must be explicitly selected.
scientific_target.case_unit: Participant × ROI complete held-video response matrix; video repetitions are nested repeated measurements.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Ten source participants, with repeated/shared video dependence across people and ROIs.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Within-person held-video prediction conditional on the selected released response estimator. Response prediction is a genuine neural target, but copying published features or values cannot establish novel independent observation understanding.
exclusions: Raw fMRI time-series or causal action-mechanism validation.
A newly unseen holdout from the public102-video test partition.
Programme encoding performance as direct/viewer interpretation.

inputs: Declared prepared training neural responses and six train/query feature pairs plus one motion-energy array.
Video identity/timing and fixed ROI/coordinate definition; query stimuli are permitted for encoding.
forbidden_inputs: Held-video neural responses, query-derived response normalization/ROI selection, answer-bearing filenames.
Shared-video target lookup through EEGMoments or other exposed BOLDMoments analyses.
observation_contract.case_identity: Manifest declares ten participants × eight ROIs =80 ordered prediction matrices and81 output files. Source actual row/coordinate IDs are not delivered here.
observation_contract.split: Declared1000 training/102 query videos, keeping all repetitions of each video together. Freeze version/feature/ROI/readout choices using training only. Public query responses remain exposed development.
observation_contract.coverage: Manifest declares101 public files/95 input files and full80 predictions; no actual packet or executable grader is packaged. This eight-ROI endpoint is distinct from070 complete46-ROI grouped-fold design.

primary.name: Participant-macro held-video response correlation
primary.aggregation: Prospective complete-participant/ROI coordinate-mean Pearson correlation using a frozen finite/constant-coordinate policy; mean ROIs within person then people. The current absent grader does not authenticate this formula.
primary.rationale: Matches the registered encoding target while making the missing implementation parity explicit; no source-transport success is substituted for prediction accuracy.

secondary: Raw unnormalized prediction error and coordinate-definedness counts.
Paired response-correlation difference to fixed static-frame/motion controls.
All80 cell scores and public-test exposure statement.

comparators.name: Static-frame linear ridge
comparators.inputs: Training/query static features with the same fitted readout capacity.
comparators.procedure: Prospective evaluator-owned training-only hyperparameter selection; same video split and coordinate support.

comparators.name: Motion/time baseline
comparators.inputs: Supplied motion-energy features and permitted run/time covariates.
comparators.procedure: Prospective independent fixed baseline, no query neural response access.

nuisance_controls: Keep video repeats/families together and record shared stimuli with EEGMoments.
Freeze Version A versus Version B; an organizer script is not a predictive reference.
Train-only normalization, feature layer/rank/readout and independent ROI choice.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired participant and shared video-family resampling is prospective; eight ROIs are repeated measures, not extra participants. Public-source exposure limits novelty regardless of local isolation.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require all80 ordered matrices with exact shape/coordinate/video IDs and finite values; missing or undefined required support blocks complete aggregate. The declared81-file transport does not validate numerical arrays.

implementation.scorer_target: The only public manifest states the frozen numerical grader is separate and its body was not read. No scientific metric implementation is delivered under this task.
implementation.delivered_scope: Legacy full programme transport declaration; source presence does not authenticate arrays or compute response correlation.
missing: Recover public-compatible numerical scorer and exact original programme source.
Qualify fixed predictive encoder and independent static/motion comparisons on full scope.
implementation.execution_evidence: Manifest reports not_run and no scientific/private grading execution. This revision inspected the declaration and official dataset metadata, without downloading response data.

direct_observation.representation: A video/stimulus observation and training response examples with predicted held-out neural responses; the current high-dimensional encoding endpoint has no direct observation packet.
direct_observation.boundary: No evaluator targets, source-label lookup, other-case memory or model/numerical tools; a direct response is evaluated separately from programme results.
missing: Authentic complete observation presentation and no-tools response collection have not been delivered.

typed_viewer.representation: Proposed typed navigation over the permitted stimulus and training-response representations.
typed_viewer.boundary: Only rendered allowed observations; no raw target arrays or unrestricted filesystem/code access. A plot alone does not establish viewer execution.
missing: Task-specific renderer/action API, complete case collection and restrictive transport are absent.

tool_assisted.representation: Case-local numerical/model-assisted investigation under a fixed observation and compute entitlement.
tool_assisted.boundary: Current query inspection may inform an allowed proposal; fit/selection remains training-only and evaluator outcomes are inaccessible. Fresh case state is required.
missing: A legacy manifest or prediction scorer does not deliver the participant investigation runtime.

frozen_program.representation: Precommitted source, fitting/adaptation recipe and complete prediction output contract.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze before query access; equal declared calibration and no post-query selection from evaluator feedback. Programme success does not measure unaided interpretation.
missing: No executable participant programme is present in the assigned package.
